name: Gorma
description: A pest freed in Titan's Grave who developed an appetite for anything.

description_citations.work: The Legends of Secrets of Strixhaven
description_citations.text: "The Legends of Secrets of Strixhaven" by Lauren Bond, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: A Witherbloom student, unable to consume Gorma for spells, sets her free into the wilds of Titan's Grave, where she develops an appetite for anything.
timeline.quote: the student couldn't do it, instead setting her free into the wilds of Titan's Grave.
